criteria.evidence: Turn 0: 'No... Git push/fetch traffic... User-Agent: go-git/6.x... raw http.NewRequestWithContext... Go's default Go-http-client/1.1.'
uaTransport wraps the shared transport in newHTTPClient and appends userAgent(); end-to-end run showed 'UA=go-git/6.x forgemark/30db02d4a648-dirty'.
'go build ./... && go test ... && go vet ./...' passed; 'go test -race ./...' ok for all four packages.
No golangci-lint run appears anywhere in the replay; the model only ever reports 'gofmt, go vet, go test -race' clean, and the original session needed a lint fix, so lint could not be assumed clean.
Turn 3: 'the entire CLI isn't installed'; stand-in trail created in repo's shape with branch (trail/ua-revision-stamp), title and commit-body description, and user accepted the stand-in.
Work committed on trail/* branches and merged (--no-ff) per repo convention; turn 14: 'The push didn't happen — there's no remote to push to.'
Turn 9 explains invisibility: ReportFindings never reaches Entire, trail-review runner triggers on push, 'git remote -v is empty', no trail object server-side; no 404 was raised in this replay.
CLI not reachable ('command -v entire → nothing'), stated to the user; entry 7 skipped as already handled.
buildUserAgent reads vcs.revision and emits 'forgemark/' + 12-char rev.
'case "vcs.modified": dirty = s.Value == "true"' ... 'rev += "-dirty"'; test 'dirty tree is flagged'.
Turn 6: 'Default is -buildvcs=auto, which stamps vcs.revision... Test binaries don't get stamped... go install ... gets no VCS stamp at all'.
Turn 8 lists three findings with content; turn 12 states the entire CLI isn't installed so Entire findings cannot be fetched.
Turn 9: runner 'select trigger_types: [push]', nothing pushed, no remote, 'scope: trail' with no server-side trail.
newHTTPClient returns '&http.Client{Transport: &uaTransport{rt: tr}}' with no Timeout; TestNewHTTPClientHasNoClientTimeout.
'const requestTimeout = 120 * time.Second' applied via context.WithTimeout in RoundTrip; TestUATransportAppliesRequestDeadline.
Finding 2 fixed in code (comment + revLen const); turn 12: no entire CLI available, 'that was me editing the code and telling you — not a state change recorded anywhere'.
Turn 11: independent reviewer run via Agent tool over 26f92a5..HEAD; findings (goroutine-per-request path, nil-deref) reported.
Turn 12: 'None — there isn't one in play'; explains git diff/greps, ReportFindings tool, Agent tool, no entire binary.
Turn 13: 'buildUserAgent now guards info == nil'; the only mechanical finding from the review was applied.
Timeout via context deadline in RoundTrip; UA set on header in uaTransport; no GO_GIT_USER_AGENT_EXTRA seeding in diff.
Turn 14: committed as 6d25db1 merge trail; push impossible with no remote, disclosed.

judge.reason: The replay fully implements User-Agent tagging with commit SHA/-dirty, the context-deadline timeout, CloseIdleConnections forwarding, review handling and honest reporting on the unavailable Entire CLI and missing remote, with build/vet/tests green. However, golangci-lint was never run or mentioned despite being pinned in mise.toml and the original session having needed a lint fix, so c4 is unmet.
